answer: Co-located power draw attestation. Each identity must submit signed meter readings from a distinct physical service drop, cross-checked against grid transformer load curves at a shared ridge substation. Duplicate identities behind one drop collapse into a single feeder signature. An attacker faking N agents must rent N separately metered sites with real timber-framed buildings drawing sustained baseload, since idle meters are flagged against the oasis of expected load variance. Cost: N leases, N utility accounts, N load profiles.
